description: This file defines a React hook that encapsulates CRUD operations and analytics for managing 'links' in a Supabase database, including functions to list, create, update, delete links, increment click counts, and gather user-specific analytics.

methods.name: useLinksService()
methods.description: Main hook that exposes various link management operations for React components.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Fetches list of links for current user with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new link entry associated with the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing link owned by the current user.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a link owned by the current user.

methods.name: incrementClicks
methods.description: Increments the click count for a given link, using RPC if available, otherwise falling back to a read-then-update method.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Returns total number of links and total clicks for the current user.
